sources.title: Masked Autoencoders / MAE (He et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: Asymmetric encoder-decoder (encoder on visible patches only, lightweight decoder) with 75% masking: 3x+ training acceleration with accuracy gains; scalable high-capacity generalizing models.
claims.context: Full-paper abstract; design + masking-ratio findings consumed.

claims.text: Reconstruction target: per-patch pixel MSE on masked patches only; FINAL recipe uses per-patch NORMALIZED pixels (default ablations use unnormalized; PCA/dVAE-token variants near-parity, tokenization unnecessary).

Ablations: decoder depth 1->8 raises linear probe 65.5->73.5 while fine-tune stays ~84.9 (width default 512-d); mask ratio optimum 75% under both protocols (linear sensitive ~20pp gap, fine-tune flat 40-80%).

Linear-vs-finetune sensitivity and recipe versions: modest linear (73.5) but strong partial/full tuning; DEFAULT recipe = 8x512 decoder, unnormalized pixels, 800 epochs; FINAL recipe = normalized pixels, 1600 epochs (no saturation to 1600).
